calculation.description: Ranks assets by 20-session momentum adjusted for the asymmetry between upside and downside return RMS. Assets whose recent movement is dominated by downside volatility are penalized; upside-dominated momentum is favored. All inputs are lagged to the completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.033893), 2023-2024 (+0.024771), and 2025-2027 (+0.023160). Small 15-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation; each observation required at least 8 valid instruments.
